description: This file defines the AjaxResponse class, which encapsulates JSON-formatted responses for AJAX calls, including status, data entries, validation messages, and serialization logic.

classes.name: AjaxResponse
classes.description: A class representing a standardized AJAX response with status, data, validation messages, and JSON serialization methods.

methods.name: addDataEntry
methods.description: Adds a data entry (key-value pair) to the data list.

methods.name: addEntry
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the data map.

methods.name: setErrorMessage
methods.description: Sets the status message based on an exception's message.

methods.name: setErrorString
methods.description: Sets the status message with a custom string.

methods.name: addValidationMessage
methods.description: Adds a validation message for a specific field.

methods.name: getJsonInfo
methods.description: Constructs a JSON string with response status and message.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Serializes the entire AjaxResponse object to a JSON string.

methods.name: getValidationMessages
methods.description: Retrieves the map of validation messages.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns the list of data entries.
